## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` …)
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run test:coverage` pass
- [ ] `npm run build && npm run test:e2e` pass for UI or animation changes
- [ ] Checked desktop and mobile widths, and reduced motion for animation changes
